invariants.rationale: Method contracts typically guarantee a non-null return unless an exception is thrown.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata should contain a valid, non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
The returned WriteStatus collection is declared as a list.
If there were input records, there should be corresponding write statuses; if there are no input records, write statuses could be empty.
All WriteStatus items in the result should be non-null for valid insertions.
